name: dgi-portfolio
description: Integrity audit for a dividend-growth portfolio (Google Sheets / xlsx) and DGI company analysis using the Dividende.blog methodology: 10-criteria scoring (max 30, floor 10) plus six valuation methods. Separates DGI from tracking-only holdings and handles the Romanian dividend tax change per payment year. Statements and dividends from SEC EDGAR, prices and a second dividend series from Tiingo. Five local MCP servers: Sheets bridge (approved writes), IBKR Flex, SEC EDGAR, prices, Alpha Vantage.
